criteria.description: [R1] `from app_int.main import subtract` succeeds, and `subtract` is callable.
[R2] `inspect.signature(subtract)` lists exactly two parameters, named `a` then `b`, and `subtract(5, 3)` called positionally does not raise.
[R5] In `src/app_int/main.py`, `subtract` has `int` annotations on `a` and `b`, an `int` return annotation, and a non-empty docstring (`subtract.__doc__` is not None or empty).
[R6] At least one test function in a file under `tests/` calls `subtract` and asserts on its return value, and pytest collects and passes it.
[R7] `health_check() == {"status": "ok"}` and `add(2, 3) == 5` still hold; the existing tests `test_health_check_reports_ok` and `test_add_returns_the_sum` are present and pass.
[R9] `uv run ruff check .` exits with status 0.
[R10] The `dependencies` and `[dependency-groups]` sections of `pyproject.toml` are the same as on the base branch.
[A1] `subtract` is defined in `src/app_int/main.py`, and no top-level `app_int/` directory has been added to the repository.
